nfl.name: NFL Elo
nfl.metric: increase in holdout log loss when the component is neutralised

features.name: Margin of victory
features.detail: every win counts the same, whatever the margin

features.name: Season regression
features.detail: ratings carry over untouched

features.name: Home advantage
features.detail: home edge set to 0 Elo

features.name: Postseason K weight
features.detail: playoff games update like any other

features.name: Rest (bye week)
features.detail: no bonus off a bye

nfl.caveat: Neutralising a component changes every rating after it, so these are contributions to the whole replay, not to one game. 'Margin of victory' clamps the margin to a point rather than removing the multiplier, which also shrinks the update size — read it as 'margin ignored', not as a clean K-preserving swap.
